name: slim the always-loaded contract back to a routing layer
objective: Bring CLAUDE.md (49,646 chars, over Claude Code's 40k-char per-file warning floor and loaded into every executor dispatch) down toward D8's <= 12 KB routing layer without dropping a load-bearing rule. A research slice first maps which reader needs each rule (orchestrator, executor, or a skill that already owns it); then cut what the code derives (Workflow Commands restates workflow.py --help) and move skill-owned detail (worktrees, design, Aside, the acceptance gate, the review boundary) to the skill or executor file that owns it. Every never-rule stays in the contract. Re-point the smoke-test pins, rebuild the installer, and ship it as a workspace release. Pays D8.
